title: RVC Voice Conversion Trainer
description: Train a Retrieval-based Voice Conversion model from a zip of one speaker's audio. Official RVC-Project pipeline (v2, 40 kHz, F0=rmvpe by default) returns inference-ready .pth + .index on your Hugging Face repo, S3 bucket or network volume. Headless official CLI — no Gradio WebUI in the worker. Not a GPT-SoVITS or Kokoro listing.

config.gpuIds: ADA_24,AMPERE_24,ADA_48_PRO,AMPERE_48,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 1g.24gb,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 2g.48gb

input.name: RVC version
input.description: v2 is the default (pretrained_v2, 768-dim HuBERT). v1 is optional and uses assets/pretrained/. Override per job with input.version.

input.name: Sample rate
input.description: 40k is the default v2 pretrain. 32k and 48k use the matching f0G/f0D weights from pretrained_v2/.

input.name: Preset
input.description: Named defaults for epochs and batch size. Explicit settings win.

input.name: Default dataset URL
input.description: https URL of a .zip/.tar.gz with wav/flac/mp3 clips of one target speaker. Transcripts are not needed. Usually sent per job (input.dataset_url).

input.name: Epochs
input.description: Official default is 200 (max 1200). Use 2 for a smoke test. Quality models typically need minutes of clean speech, not a handful of clips.

input.name: Batch size
input.description: Per-GPU batch size. Official default is 8. Automatically lowered if the sliced dataset is smaller.

input.name: F0 method
input.description: Pitch extractor. rmvpe (default) runs on CUDA in half precision. pm is a CPU fallback. Harvest/FCPE are not exposed in this worker.

input.name: Hugging Face output repo
input.description: Optional 'user/repo' to upload the .pth + .index + model card. Needs HF_TOKEN with write access.

input.name: HF_TOKEN
input.description: Hugging Face token with write access, only needed for HF_OUTPUT_REPO. Pretrained weights (lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI) are public and do not need a token. Use a Runpod secret: {{ RUNPOD_SECRET_hf_token }}. Never put the token in the job input.

input.name: Training watchdog (s)
input.description: Kill training after this many seconds (0 = off). Keep below the endpoint execution timeout. A cold start may download ~0.55 GiB of public pretrained weights.
